text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Visiting South African president Nelson Mandela on Monday deplored trade imbalances between his country and Zimbabwe, saying it was a matter of strategic importance to redress the current situation in which trade is weighted heavily in favour of South Africa.
- Africa can only be an equal partner in world affairs it it takes full responsibility for its short-comings first, President Mandela said in Harare on Monday.
